intro: Flicker is where style meets storage. Crafted from solid Sheesham wood in a warm walnut shade, it brings elegance, function, and flexibility to your entertainment zone.

features.title: Built from solid strength
features.text: Crafted with Sheesham wood, your TV unit is sturdy, durable, and made to last through all your binge-watch marathons.

features.title: Elegance in every tone
features.text: The fine walnut finish adds a refined warmth to your space—classic, versatile, and full of natural charm.

features.title: Display made simple
features.text: With open tower shelves, you get easy-access display areas for books, décor, or your favorite collectables.

features.title: Style meets storage
features.text: Decorative carved shutters add a traditional flair while offering closed storage for all your living room essentials.

features.title: Tidy by design
features.text: An effective wire management system helps keep your cables out of sight and your setup neat and organised.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
